description: This file defines the PieLegendRenderer class responsible for rendering the legend in pie charts within the PDFsharp.Charting library. It initializes legend display information, including font, color, border, and entries based on chart data.

classes.name: PieLegendRenderer
classes.description: A specialized renderer for pie chart legends, responsible for initializing legend display information based on chart data.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the renderer info for the pie chart legend, including font, border, and legend entries based on the chart's data.
